title: Sound test and Durham's birth date and place
summary: After a sound check, Durham gives his birth as 19 August 1909 in San Marcos, Texas, though books say 1906.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Now we're testing, one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. And today we're recording Eddie Durham.
Yeah, but they got six. I was going to let it stay like that. It was a credit.
They got 1906 in all the books they got on that.
Well, we'll put three years on it.
What do you think, we should stick to that 1906?
They seem to think it's quite a novelty. That's because (unintelligible.)
And this was in San Marcos, Texas.
